title: Acyclicity of a list with a first gate
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $g$ be a gate, and let $gs$ be a finite list of gates. The list consisting of $g$ followed by $gs$ is acyclic starting from index bound $n$ if and only if every input index read by $g$ is less than $n$ and $gs$ is acyclic starting from $n+1$.
hypotheses_covered: $gs$ is a finite list of gates
